description: This file manages the display and editing of user profile privileges within the vtiger CRM system, including global, module, field, tab, and utility permissions. It utilizes Smarty templates for rendering the UI and interacts with the database to retrieve and update profile settings.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty class instance used for rendering the profile privilege interface.

methods.name: getGlobalDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns HTML code for displaying global permission icon based on permission ID.

methods.name: getGlobalDisplayOutput
methods.description: Returns HTML checkbox input for global permissions (view/edit all).

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns HTML image icon based on permission ID.

methods.name: getDisplayOutput
methods.description: Returns HTML checkbox input for specific tab/module permissions.

methods.name: profileExists
methods.description: Checks in the database whether a profile with the specified ID exists.
